confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on web-search summaries of cost-of-living aggregators and articles. Numbeo's Tainan figures put a cappuccino at about NT$103, a domestic draft beer at about NT$100 and an inexpensive meal at about NT$120, and some entries look over a year old. Other aggregators put a mid-range meal for two at roughly US$18-25 and an inexpensive meal at US$5-7. Articles and menus from 2024-2026 put Tainan cocktails at about NT$320-500, but craft bars run higher than a standard cocktail, so I set that anchor lower. I found no Tainan glass-of-wine price, so wine is inferred from the local cocktail and beer relationship (about 0.8x cocktail). NT$ prices were converted at roughly 32.4 TWD per USD. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026. I ran no accommodation searches and inspected no live listings, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan-specific aggregator data was used where available. Accommodation was scaled holistically from general knowledge of other mid-sized Taiwanese cities such as Taichung and Kaohsiung, generally below Taipei.
